These applications coming on for admission this day, the   the following:
ORDER Heard and perused the record.

This order shall govern the disposal of these bail applications as they are arisen out of same crime of the police station, hence, they are heard analogously and are being decided by this common order.

2. These are first bail applications filed on behalf of the applicants under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail relating to Crime No.723/2023 registered at Police Station-Vijay Nagar, District-Indore (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471,
120-B/34 of IPC, 1860.
Applicants Abhishek and Kanchan are in custody since 04.01.2024 and 08.01.2024, respectively.
3. As per prosecution story, it is alleged that the applicants have committed cheating with the complainants by making forged marksheets.
4. Learned counsel for the applicants submitted that the applicants are innocent and have been falsely implicated in this case.
He further submits that applicants are implicated in the present case only on the basis of memo of co- accused Dinesh and Manish about helping them in making forged mark sheets and degrees.
It is further submitted that only photographs of the mark sheets were recovered from the applicants and there is nothing on record to connect the applicants with the aforesaid offence.
Applicants have parity with co- accused Ganesh, Sanjay Tilakwar, Narendra Kumar Joshi, who have already been enlarged on bail.
Applicants Abhishek and Kanchan are in custody since 04.01.2024 and 08.01.2024, respectively and final conclusion of trial will take sufficient long time.
Under these circumstances, counsel prays for grant of bail to the applicants.
5. On the other hand, learned Govt. Advocate opposed the prayer and prayed for its rejection.
6. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and looking to the facts and circumstances of the case as well as custody period, I am inclined to release the applicants on bail.
Consequently, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, b ail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure filed on behalf of applicants, stands allowed.

7. It is directed that applicants be released on bail on their furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) each with one solvent surety each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for their regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with Kanchan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/98343957/
2 a condition that they shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
